paper_title: Automatic Evaluation of Attribution by Large Language Models
caption: Data source distribution of combined training and AttrEval-Simulation sets.
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources within a combined training set. The chart is divided into twelve segments, each representing a different data source. These segments, ordered approximately from largest to smallest, are labeled NQ (31.3%, blue), SCIFACT (16.1%, light blue), SNLI (15.4%, green), MULTINC (13.0%, orange), SCITAIL (11.3%, pink), ANLI (4.6%, yellow), FACTCC (2.6%, purple), ENTFA (1.8%, grey), PUBHEALTH (1.2%, light green), MULTIFC (0.5%, dark grey), FACTCC (0.5%, red), and XSUMHUL (0.1%, teal). Percentage labels are displayed directly within each slice. A legend appears above the chart, listing each data source label.
